$comment: Shared by exercises and plans. `ordinal` is for sorting and for filtering "at or below my level". Four levels rather than three because calisthenics skills (planche, front lever, one-arm pull-up) sit well beyond what "advanced" means for a barbell lift, and collapsing them hides the gap from the member.

items.label: Beginner
items.description: New to structured training, or returning after a long break.
items.guidance: Prioritise movement quality and consistency over load.

items.label: Intermediate
items.description: Six months or more of consistent training, competent in the main lifts.

items.label: Advanced
items.description: Years of consistent training, near their practical ceiling.
items.guidance: Periodised blocks; small gains need specific targeting.

items.label: Elite
items.description: Skills that take years of dedicated practice and that most trainees never reach.
items.guidance: Practise fresh and far from failure. Almost exclusively calisthenics statics and one-arm work.
